purpose: Sequentially update a persistent joint posterior over fault hypothesis H and likelihood/calibration scenario S, rather than reusing fixed scenario weights as if S were independently redrawn for every observation.

scope.candidate_binding: One immutable selected candidate and its exact likelihood-model, calibration-review and scenario manifest are fixed for one posterior ledger.
scope.hypothesis_space: Sorted stable hypothesis IDs; candidate likelihood vector positions follow this canonical order.
scope.scenario_space: Sorted unique scenario IDs and positive initial weights that sum to one; all scenarios share an identical outcome ID space.
scope.prior: Genesis uses p(H,S)=p(H)*p(S), where scenario weights are the declared prior over persistent epistemic alternatives. This factorization is an explicit assumption of v0.1.
scope.observation: Each externally acquired outcome is applied once using the scenario-specific likelihood p(o|H,S).

update.formula: p_t(H,S|o) = p_(t-1)(H,S) * p(o|H,S) / sum_(H,S) p_(t-1)(H,S) * p(o|H,S)
update.persistent_uncertainty: The posterior over S is carried forward. A repeated observation updates the same persistent S; it is never reset to the original scenario weights.
outputs: joint entropy and realized entropy reduction
update.surprising_observation: Realized entropy reduction may be negative for an individual outcome; KL divergence remains non-negative within numerical tolerance.

ledger.receipt_replay: Reapply the exact outcome IDs and receipt digests in append order from genesis to reproduce every ledger.
ledger.integrity_limit: SHA-256 links content and ordering; it does not authenticate observation signer, sensor source, timestamp, authorization or physical truth.

hard_gates: start the ledger only from a candidate selected by replay of the exact frozen evidence portfolio and selection baseline
the candidate manifest must be recomputed and match the immutable candidate ID and likelihood model
candidate hypothesis-space digest must match the stable ordered hypothesis ID set
at least two unique likelihood scenarios are required
scenario IDs are sorted canonically; initial scenario weights are finite, strictly positive and sum to one
every scenario has the same outcome ID set and normalized likelihoods for every hypothesis
joint posterior cells are stored in a strict hypothesis-major, scenario-minor order
genesis joint prior is p(H) multiplied by the declared persistent scenario prior p(S)
every observation uses p(outcome | H,S) from its matching persistent scenario
scenario posterior weights are updated after every outcome and never reset to their initial weights
zero-probability observations fail closed; no infinite evidence or forced class assignment
an observation receipt digest may be applied only once in a ledger chain
each updated ledger binds its parent ledger digest and exact ordered receipt history
ledger digest and joint probability normalization are recomputed on every update
changing candidate, likelihood model, calibration, hypothesis space or scenario space requires a new selection and a new ledger
source receipt digest is not treated as signer authentication; upstream identity, authority, timestamp and sensor provenance checks remain mandatory
the module performs posterior arithmetic only; it does not acquire a sample, operate equipment, conduct an inspection or authorize an intervention

comparators.method: Deliberately incorrect baseline that re-applies the original scenario weights as an independent draw at each observation; retain only as a falsification comparator.
Proposed persistent joint posterior; carries p(H,S) across sequential observations and reports hypothesis and scenario marginals.
Single frozen likelihood model with p(H) updates; useful only when scenario uncertainty is absent or already resolved.

research_targets_not_achieved.target: 100% of joint posterior ledgers reproduce exactly from genesis, frozen likelihood manifests and ordered observation receipts.
Sequential observations update p(S) as well as p(H), and matched tests distinguish the result from re-marginalizing original scenario weights at every step.
Zero accepted non-finite, negative or non-normalized joint posterior cells under the frozen boundary and adversarial numerical suite.
Zero duplicate, reordered, cross-candidate or altered-receipt observations accepted into a qualified ledger.

limitations.factorized_genesis_prior: v0.1 assumes prior independence between H and S. If domain knowledge requires dependence, a separately reviewed joint prior manifest is required before use.
limitations.single_candidate_scope: A ledger is bound to one candidate likelihood model. Switching measurement type, likelihood model or calibration is not automatically composable in v0.1.
limitations.calibration: The updater does not create or validate likelihood scenarios; scenario calibration and coverage remain independent evidence gates.
limitations.authentication: The updater validates receipt digest format and binds it into the ledger, but source authenticity and authorization remain upstream trust responsibilities.
limitations.claim_ceiling: Source-authored Bayesian ledger and synthetic fixtures only until exact-head compilation, tests, independent mathematical review, calibrated scenario data and external receipt verification are complete.
